title: API keys, credentials, and configuration parameters embedded in the MatchPoint APK, which can be… (CVE-2026-111495)
description: The MatchPoint APK contains embedded API keys, credentials, and configuration parameters that can be extracted via reverse engineering. The vendor clarifies that some of these elements, such as Google Maps and Firebase keys, are project identifiers rather than authentication secrets. The security impact varies depending on the specific capabilities and restrictions of the exposed elements. No known exploits are reported in the wild, and no patches or fixes have been indicated.
